newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Bell in court on 170 child sex charges.
newsitem.headline: Australian Bell in court on 170 child sex charges.

text.p: Former Australian millionaire Philip Bell appeared briefly in a Sydney court on Saturday on 170 charges of sexual assault against boys aged 11 to 17.
Bell, 62, was remanded in custody to reappear on Friday, police told Reuters.
The charges relate to offences that allegedly happened between 1977 and 1992 in New South Wales state.

Bell was extradited from South Africa, arriving late Friday, and held in police custody. He had been arrested in January at the South African seaside resort of Jeffreys Bay, where he ran a surfing school for youngsters, after a 10-month worldwide police hunt.
